lead.event: Adaro Andalan Indonesia announces US$500 million interim dividend
lead.headline: AADI announces US$500 million interim dividend
lead.blurb: Adaro Andalan Indonesia approved the cash dividend on 25 November, doubling its US$250 million interim payout in 2025. It is sourced from net profit for the nine months ended 30 September 2026. The per-share amount has not been announced, and rupiah conversion will use Bank Indonesia’s middle rate announced on 7 December, with payment scheduled for 11 December.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Bank Syariah Indonesia receives approval for 6.8 billion-share rights issue
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BRIS receives approval for 6.8 billion-share rights issue
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Shareholders approved the capital increase at an extraordinary meeting on 6 November. Bank Syariah Indonesia will use net proceeds to support financing growth, placing funds temporarily in safe, liquid instruments if not immediately deployed. Trading and exercise are scheduled for 18–24 February 2027, with new shares recorded on the exchange on 18 February.

other.event: Adhi Karya secures Rp1.29 trillion contract for 26 irrigation projects
other.headline: ADHI secures Rp1.29 trillion contract for 26 irrigation projects
other.blurb: The award directly impacts Adhi Karya's construction order backlog. Further details were not available.

deals_control.event: Energi Mega Persada completes US$200 million investment in HighPeak Energy
deals_control.headline: Energi Mega Persada completes US$200 million investment in HighPeak Energy
deals_control.blurb: The investment was made through subsidiary Tunas Harapan Perkasa in Nasdaq-listed HighPeak Energy. Energi Mega Persada said it targets operational synergies and technology transfer, with the deal potentially adding around 47 million barrels of oil equivalent in economic exposure to its 14-asset portfolio.

earnings_guidance.event: BUMI reports nine-month 2026 net profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: BUMI reports 190.45% nine-month profit growth
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bumi Resources' profit attributable to owners rose 405% to US$148.47 million, while revenue increased 38.85% to US$1.44 billion. The figures cover the nine months ended 30 September 2026.

earnings_guidance.event: Hana Bank reports nine-month 2026 earnings and loan growth
earnings_guidance.headline: Hana Bank reports Rp541.86 billion profit and 8.03% loan growth
earnings_guidance.blurb: Operating expenses fell to Rp656.97 billion from Rp776.19 billion, supporting 12.63% year-on-year profit growth. Gross and net NPLs were 0.44% and 0.18%. Director Hendri Setiawan said Hana Bank was optimistic about meeting its 2026 target and planned credit optimization and retail expansion in 2027.
